title: Grain Marketing Contracts: Releasing a Member's Money on a Settlement Statement
content:
Where grain sold under Grain Marketing Contracts has been drawn onto a settlement statement, the grain desk pays the member for it and records how the money went out. The result governed is the money released to the member on that statement, written onto the member's grain ledger as one payment line against the named contract and statement.

The money released on a statement is fixed only after the carry owed on every parcel that has left the member's unpriced position stands as a charge line on the grain ledger. Funds are released on a statement only after every signed roll instruction standing against the contract is matched by a roll confirmation on the grain ledger.

**Capability.** The call writes one payment line onto the member's grain ledger against the named contract and statement, carrying the amount released and the way the member elected to be paid; the statement itself, its charge lines and the contract's standing are left as they are. On success the payment shows on the member's grain ledger against that statement and the money is out of the grain account.

**How it is invoked.** The recorded act is `release_grain_settlement_payment_379b8a52`. It is not among the desk's listed tools: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**The parameters it takes.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format or candidates |
|---|---|---|
| `contract_id` | the internal reference of the grain marketing contract the statement was drawn on; it identifies one contract record and is reachable from the grain contract lookup for the member before this call | an identifier |
| `customer_id` | the internal reference of the member being paid; it identifies one membership record and is reachable from the membership profile lookup before this call | an identifier |
| `settlement_number` | the settlement statement being paid | written as S- followed by six digits, for example S-551903, in upper case with the hyphen and with no spaces; never left blank |
| `payment_method` | how the money reaches the member on this release | one of `check`, `ach`, `credit_to_input_account`, `deferred_payment` |
| `payment_amount_usd` | the money released to the member on this payment | in USD to 2 decimal places, as a positive number with no currency symbol and no thousands separator, rounded half away from zero at the cent when a longer value is supplied |

The four candidates for `payment_method` carry these meanings: `check`, where the member is paid by a cheque drawn on the cooperative and mailed or held for collection; `ach`, where the money is sent by direct deposit to the bank account the member has lodged; `credit_to_input_account`, where the member has elected the whole of this money to be applied against their crop input account instead of being paid out; and `deferred_payment`, where the member has elected the payment to be held and released in a later tax year under a deferral their programme allows.

**What comes back.** A single confirmation sentence in plain text naming the ledger line reference minted for the payment, the settlement statement it was released against, the way it went out, and the amount in USD to 2 decimal places; that sentence, rather than an error text, is what indicates the money was released.
